risk_note: RV2 orders (B1-04zzab; 08 BR-FUND-22 决-06 实测前 A, BR-FUND-02; 规划/12 §1.3 处罚表; orchestrator D10-2335 (c3), D10-2402, D10-2412, D10-2449). punish.window now branches on punish_status: 0 and a missing field go to the writer as before (the missing ones counted apart); 1 (unfrozen) and any other value are never given to the writer — no order_rights row, no R6 / R8, no ledger entry, no order column touched, an earlier clawback stays — and become an UNFREEZE_SIGNAL / UNMAPPED_STATUS record in app.order_sync_pending with one warn per window and kind. The pending write is the window's own single INSERT … ON CONFLICT on order_sync_pending_open_key behind the sub-order advisory lock (one open record per key; an existing record keeps raw_status, gets this signal's mark appended to detail, order_id filled when it was null, detected_at the later one; the order lookup carries app_id). A window that stops part way warns for the kinds it recorded or failed to record and rethrows the error. Production wiring injects the real recorder; without it these rows still never reach the writer. No amount is computed anywhere on this path; no migration; the order sync's shared writePending is unchanged. One frozen test follows the rule ([AC-B1-04zza#32], owner agreed 2026-11-21, D10-2425; record below). Known limits, ruled out of this task: the reverse order of two evidence sources on one key and the order sync's repeat judgement on a record that carries a punish mark (FU-PENDING-MERGE-ORDER-SYNC-SIDE, D10-2468); mark values cut at 64 code points and detail capped at 2000 characters; the monitoring rule for the two warns (FU-B1-04ZZAB-UNFREEZE-ALERT-RULE); the PAID / ESTIMATED rule-test gap of spec-test r3 (FU-B1-04ZZAB-SPEC-R3-GAP, right after this merge; checked in code by the money review). Test machine on the rebased head ffee7f0c72e4 (tree a7d3457ebae6): verify-sharded-summary green with scope fast+test:int+test:browser (verify:fast exit 0 on its second run — the first hit the 3600 s limit while sharing the machine with this lane's other segments, no failing output; test:int segments 1-6 and rest all exit 0, 2193 files / 19904 tests = int_files_total; --browser exit 0 incl. build-smoke), not_covered test:smoke and db:check (not run on the test machine; this task has no migration). The required CI checks are the full verification.
